text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) (No. 4) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 22 Ogos 2011.

Pindaan Jadual

2. (1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] dipinda dalam Jadual

dengan memasukkan selepas butiran 17 butiran yang berikut:

"18. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur Fasa 2

yang bermula dari KM 424.793 (di koordinat U 34307.904,

T 13156.195 Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu) sehingga ke KM 2.478

di Persimpangan Jalan Bukit Jong (di koordinat U 44038.412,

T 14973.691 Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu).".

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR FASA 2

Dibuat 22 Ogos 2011

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/11 Jld.2; PN(PU2)/460/LXIII]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

 Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) (NO. 4) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

(No. 4 ) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 22 August 2011.

Amendment of Schedule

2. (1) The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] is amended in the

Schedule by inserting after item 17 the following item:

"18. The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway Phase 2

commencing from KM 424.793 (at coordinates N 34307.904,

E 13156.195 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid) up to KM 2.478 at

Bukit Jong Road Junction (at coordinates N 44038.412, E 14973.691 of

the Terengganu State Cassini Grid).".

(2) The road with the speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY PHASE 2

Made 22 August 2011

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/6/11 Jld.2; PN(PU2)/460/LXIII]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

 Minister of Transport
